short_description: Exploring the mysterious forest beyond the wards

text_blocks.content: Ignoring the others' protests, you step beyond the protective wards of Thornreach Grove, the familiar hum of magic fading behind you. The forest grows dark and twisted, the trees gnarled and reaching. The whispers of The Veil grow louder, like a thousand forgotten voices calling out to you.
What are you doing? The wards are the only thing keeping us safe from The Veil's corruption. We should not venture out there, not without knowing the risks.
The mist thickens, obscuring your vision. You can barely make out the outlines of the trees surrounding you. The air feels heavy, charged with an unseen energy.
Stay close. We don't know what lies beyond the wards. This forest... it feels alive, watching us.
A faint glimmer catches your eye in the distance, a flickering light through the fog. Curiosity gets the better of you, and you move towards it, the others reluctantly following.
